targets_restated_from.meropenem_pk_1g: Targets: RMSE < 0.15 log10 mg/L; Cmax ratio within +/-20%; AUC0-8h within +/-15%.
targets_restated_from.meropenem_neutropenic_thigh: Success: model stasis threshold within ~5-10 pp of 17.3%; monotonic sigmoidal kill curve.

terminal_half_life_h.note: not a registry target; recorded because the two targets above both follow from it

meropenem_neutropenic_thigh.published_source: Sabet M et al. Antimicrob Agents Chemother 2020; stasis, 1-log and 2-log at 17.3, 26.0 and 41.7 %24-h fT>MIC

summary.interpretation: Both failures run in the same direction -- the model needs more exposure than the data do -- and both follow from a terminal half-life that is too short, so the plasma profile decays faster than observed and the time spent above any threshold is understated.

provenance.endpoint: curve-level validation against registry acceptance targets
provenance.exposure_index: %fT>MIC for the dose-response; plasma mg/L for the PK
